descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world . 
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer to join our team and play a pivotal role in the design, development and maintenance of our applications. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Software Architects and other developers to deliver high-quality software solutions and contribute to the success of key business initiatives.
 This role is primarily focused on backend development using C# and .NET, with approximately 10% frontend interaction (Angular or VueJs). 
 What you will do: 
Collaborate with Business System Analysts, Software Architects and other developers to understand project requirements and objectives.
Perform technical analysis for selected requirements.
Develop and maintain backend components, services and APIs.
Write clean, efficient and well-documented code using modern development practices.
Ensure the quality of developed solutions through proper testing activities.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical production issues (3rd level support).
Contribute to frontend development activities when required (approximately 10% of the role).
Stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices to continuously improve development processes.
 What you must have: 
5+ years of experience working with C#, .NET and SQL .
Experience developing backend applications and web services.
Experience with REST/Open APIs .
Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles.
Good knowledge of SOLID principles and clean coding practices.
Ability to work autonomously and write clean, maintainable code.
Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Good English skills.
 Nice to have: 
Experience with frontend frameworks such as Angular or VueJs .
Knowledge of Azure DevOps Server .
Experience working in Agile environments.
Willingness to learn new technologies and contribute beyond core responsibilities.
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes .
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package.
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills.
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything. they do and understand the importance of team spirit.
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things.
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do.
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams.
 SII Romania is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity, equality and inclusion within our workforce and working environment. For this purpose, we encourage all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, sexual orientation, race ethnicity, beliefs, marital status, disability or other characteristics to send us their applications.
 ***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
